diagrams.title: chat-stop-proxy: Stop Button & Claude Code Proxy Interactions
diagrams.content:
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant ChatInput
    participant useHQ
    participant chatStore
    participant llmBridge
    participant LLM
    participant launchTerminal
    participant PTY as Claude Code PTY
    participant MessageList

    Note over User,MessageList: Conv 1 — Stop Button (LLM mode)

    User->>ChatInput: type message + click Send
    ChatInput->>useHQ: onSend(prompt)
    useHQ->>chatStore: setLoading(true)
    useHQ->>chatStore: addMessage({role:'assistant', status:'streaming'})
    useHQ->>LLM: askLlm(prompt)
    LLM-->>useHQ: stream tokens
    useHQ->>chatStore: updateLastMessage({content})
    chatStore-->>MessageList: re-render streaming bubble

    alt User clicks Stop
        User->>ChatInput: click Square icon
        ChatInput->>useHQ: onStop()
        useHQ->>llmBridge: abortLlm()
        llmBridge->>llmBridge: window.pathly.llm.abort()
        useHQ->>chatStore: updateLastMessage({status:'done'})
        useHQ->>chatStore: setLoading(false)
        chatStore-->>MessageList: render partial bubble (done)
    else Stream completes naturally
        LLM-->>useHQ: stream end
        useHQ->>chatStore: updateLastMessage({status:'done'})
        useHQ->>chatStore: setLoading(false)
        chatStore-->>MessageList: render complete bubble
    end

    Note over User,MessageList: Conv 2 — Claude Code Proxy (claude mode)

    User->>ChatInput: switch mode toggle to Claude Code
    ChatInput->>chatStore: setChatMode('claude')

    User->>ChatInput: type message + click Send
    ChatInput->>useHQ: onSend(prompt)
    useHQ->>chatStore: setLoading(true)
    useHQ->>chatStore: addMessage({role:'assistant', status:'streaming', source:'claude-code'})
    useHQ->>launchTerminal: writeToTerminal('claude', prompt, projectPath)
    launchTerminal->>PTY: spawn claude -p prompt
    PTY-->>launchTerminal: tabId
    launchTerminal-->>useHQ: tabId
    useHQ->>PTY: window.pathly.terminal.onData(tabId, cb)
    PTY-->>useHQ: output lines (streaming)
    useHQ->>chatStore: appendOutputLine('claude', line)
    useHQ->>chatStore: updateLastMessage({content})
    chatStore-->>MessageList: streaming bubble with CC badge
    PTY-->>useHQ: idle timeout (12 s)
    useHQ->>chatStore: updateLastMessage({status:'done'})
    useHQ->>chatStore: setLoading(false)
    chatStore-->>MessageList: final CC bubble (done)
